stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait, pick your options, then turn the phone to landscape when the game asks you to.
stumbles.why: Locking rotation in portrait means the phone's screen won't rotate when turned, yet it says to turn to landscape. It's unclear whether turning the phone physically is enough. It's also unclear what the game's prompt does.

stumbles.quote: leaving auto-rotate on would make the screen turn twice
stumbles.why: It doesn't say what 'turn twice' means (the game's own rotation plus the OS rotation?). It also hints at an earlier version without explaining.

stumbles.quote: The first screen, held in portrait, has the race options:
stumbles.why: The options list gives no choices for Laps or Difficulty, so the available values are unknown.

stumbles.quote: Top of the phone away from you
stumbles.why: In landscape, 'top' is ambiguous. It could mean the edge that was top in portrait or the edge that is now up. It's unclear which way to tilt.

stumbles.quote: On iOS, tap allow when the game asks for motion access.
stumbles.why: It doesn't say what Android users should expect, or whether any permission is needed there.

point: Open the page on a phone with a motion sensor, lock rotation in portrait, choose track, laps and difficulty, tap Start engine, turn to landscape, and steer by tilting from the neutral pose captured when the lights go out.
